entries.title: Darksiders
entries.definitive_edition: Darksiders Warmastered Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the updated Warmastered PC build.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Warmastered PC presentation with 60 FPS-class gameplay and current patch support.

primary.why: The Windows PC Warmastered route is the best version because it upgrades the original with higher resolution support, improved textures, rendering/shadows/post-processing, 60 FPS gameplay, and the 2026 PC update alongside current-gen console support.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Darksiders Warmastered Edition on Steam or GOG and play the updated Windows PC build.

all_releases.reason: skip: superseded for a new playthrough by Warmastered Edition.

all_releases.fidelity: Remaster with improved textures, rendering, shadows, post-processing, 60 FPS gameplay, and 2026 PC patch support.

all_releases.reason: skip: same remastered content family, but no sourced exclusive content over PC.
skip: useful handheld route, but no sourced exclusive content and lower capture/fidelity priority than Windows PC.
skip: current console route, but the updated PC version remains the best capture/settings target.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Warmastered Edition is available on the PC primary route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use Warmastered rather than the original release for a new playthrough.

entries.title: Darksiders II
entries.definitive_edition: Darksiders II: Deathinitive Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native Deathinitive PC release.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Deathinitive Edition PC presentation with DLC included.

primary.why: The Windows PC Deathinitive Edition is the best route because it replaces the original digital release, integrates the story expansions and extra equipment, improves graphics/lighting/balance, and keeps PC capture/settings flexibility.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Darksiders II: Deathinitive Edition on Steam or GOG and play the Windows PC build.

all_releases.platform: Windows PC / PlayStation 3 / Xbox 360 / Wii U (original)
all_releases.fidelity: Original release family before Deathinitive Edition.
all_releases.reason: skip: superseded by Deathinitive Edition, which integrates DLC and balance/visual updates.

all_releases.fidelity: Deathinitive Edition with integrated DLC, enhanced graphics/lighting, balance adjustments, and PC capture/settings flexibility.

all_releases.reason: skip: same complete edition family, with no sourced exclusive content over Windows PC.
skip: useful handheld route, but no sourced exclusive content and lower capture/fidelity priority than Windows PC.
skip: cloud access route, not a current archival recommendation versus native PC.
skip: strong console route, but no sourced exclusive content over Windows PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Deathinitive Edition includes the key DLC and is available on the PC primary route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use Deathinitive Edition rather than the delisted/original digital release.

entries.title: Darksiders III
entries.definitive_edition: Darksiders III with The Crucible and Keepers of the Void on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release with DLC installed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Unreal Engine 4 PC presentation with DLC.

primary.why: The Windows PC Deluxe/DLC route is the best version because it has the full game, The Crucible, Keepers of the Void, and PC capture/settings flexibility. The Switch and Stadia ports add access routes but no sourced exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Darksiders III on Steam or GOG with The Crucible and Keepers of the Void DLC installed. Play the main campaign and then the DLC content.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Unreal Engine 4 PC release with DLC available on the same platform.
all_releases.reason: primary: best complete route when paired with The Crucible and Keepers of the Void.
skip: same game/DLC family, with no sourced exclusive content over Windows PC.
skip: cloud access route, not a current archival recommendation versus native PC.
skip: useful handheld route, but no sourced exclusive content and lower capture/fidelity priority than Windows PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The major DLC packs are available on the PC primary route.

entries.remaster_caveats: No separate remaster is documented; install the DLC for the complete route.

entries.title: Darksiders Genesis

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release for solo or co-op capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Unreal Engine 4 PC presentation with co-op support.

primary.why: The Windows PC release is the best route because it launched with Stadia first, supports the full solo/co-op prequel, and offers PC capture/settings flexibility. Physical collector editions add extras such as a board game, not platform-exclusive video-game content.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Darksiders Genesis on Steam or GOG and play the Windows PC build solo or in co-op.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with solo/co-op support and capture/settings flexibility.
all_releases.reason: primary: best fidelity/capture route for the complete prequel.
skip: not a current archival recommendation versus native PC.
skip: same game route, with no sourced exclusive content over Windows PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced platform-exclusive game content route is needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: Collector/Nephilim editions contain physical/digital extras rather than a different gameplay version.
